POC goals / success criteria:
- Verify 95th/99th p95 p99 latency SLOs under steady-state traffic (target p95 < 150ms for chat generation; p99 < 350ms).
- Validate throughput at 150 concurrent requests with batching enabled.
- Measure cost delta vs Hosted API (< 35% reduction target for embeddings-heavy reranking flow).
- Test robustness of fallback routing: model variant fallback + region failover with < 200ms additional tail latency when routed to fallback.
- Confirm audit logging and KMS integration for customer keys.

POC technical plan (agreed with SE):
- Infra kickoff (week 1): networking handshake, VPC peering/VPN, IP allowlist, egress ports, firewall rules. SE to provide exact egress list and NAT IP pool.
- Canary phase (days 3–10): route 10% live production traffic through Dedicated canary pool in us-west-2. Canary profile: small subset of customers (internal + Beta customers). Metrics collection: latency by endpoint, token cost, error rates, KV cache hit ratio.
- Ramp plan (days 11–14): conditional ramp to 50% then backdown if regressions. Rollback immediate to Hosted if error spike > 2x baseline or p99 latency regression > 30%.
- Fallback routing design:
  - Primary model: quantized 8-bit Llama-variant in Dedicated for cost-performance.
  - Fallbacks: (1) higher-precision variant in Dedicated (auto-scale) (2) Hosted API model variant in eu-west-1/us-east as cross-region fallback.
  - Route decision layer: traffic router to evaluate SLO breach or instance failures and switch to next available variant/region.
- Canary health checks & automatic rollback: SE to install tracing hooks, and Console dashboard alerts tied to SLO thresholds (auto-rollover disabled; manual rollback toggle kept for first POC).

Security & compliance notes:
- Require SSO/SAML integration for admin console.
- KMS for key management mandatory; need whitepaper on key lifecycle.
- Audit logs retention: initial ask 1 year, may expand.
- SOC2 attestation required before procurement.
